name: Read-only access to parsed knowledge documents
description: Read-only access to parsed knowledge documents Read-only access to parsed knowledge documents. GET /api/projects/{project_id}/business_knowledge/documents/search/
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/business_knowledge/documents/search/
Read-only access to parsed knowledge documents. Exposes hybrid search (``search``) and a drill-down window (``window``) so an agent (PHAI or MCP) can find and explore business knowledge chunks.
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.; query (query) — Natural-language search query. Runs hybrid (semantic + full-text) retrieval over all SAFE, READY knowledge chunks in this project.
Optional: limit (query) — Maximum number of ranked chunks to return. Defaults to 10, capped at 20.; rerank (query) — When true, rerank search results with a listwise LLM pass for better relevance. Defaults to false (RRF order only). Falls back to RRF order on rerank failure.

Read-only access to parsed knowledge documents. Exposes hybrid search (``search``) and a drill-down window (``window``) so an agent (PHAI or MCP) can find and explore business knowledge chunks.
Required: around_ordinal (query) — Zero-based chunk ordinal to center the window on (from a search result).; id (path) — A UUID string identifying this knowledge document.; project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: radius (query) — Number of chunks before and after the center to include. Defaults to 5, clamped to [0, 15].

name: Surfaces topics the support AI couldn't answer from the knowledge base
description: Surfaces topics the support AI couldn't answer from the knowledge base Surfaces topics the support AI couldn't answer from the knowledge base. POST /api/projects/{project_id}/business_knowledge/gap_suggestions/{id}/accept/
context:
POST /api/projects/{project_id}/business_knowledge/gap_suggestions/{id}/accept/
Surfaces topics the support AI couldn't answer from the knowledge base. Two list shapes controlled by the ``ticket_id`` query param: - **per-ticket** (``?ticket_id= ``): individual gap rows for that ticket. - **aggregated** (no ``ticket_id``): gaps grouped by normalized topic with counts, for the Business knowledge suggestions panel.
Required: id (path) — A UUID string identifying this knowledge gap suggestion.; project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: body (body)
